items.title: little me vs. me now, set to Pink Floyd
items.body: a childhood photo, then a recent one, to Pink Floyd's "Time." one guy went from a toy firefighter hat to an actual firefighter uniform. i'm not crying, you're crying.

items.title: "how many taps until my pet gets mad"
items.body: exactly what it sounds like: people tap their cat or dog and count how long until it's DONE with them. top one has 15.5M views.

items.title: the fake boyfriend text prank on dad
